SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
SET @end_t1=concat(@b_year-1,'1231');
SET @end_t2=concat(@b_year,'0331');
SET @end_t3=concat(@b_year,'0630');
SET @end_t4=concat(@b_year,'0930');


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_height05(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  targetq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  targetq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  targetq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  targetq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	resultq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,	
	
	b2q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	b2q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	b2q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	b2q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	a2q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	a2q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	a2q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	a2q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	
	b3q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	b3q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	b3q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	b3q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	a3q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	a3q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	a3q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	a3q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

  target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,	
	result5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,	
	result6 int(9) DEFAULT 0,	
	
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','target',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','result1',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','result2',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','result3',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','result4',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','result5',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','result6',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','totalq1',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','totalq2',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','totalq3',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_height05','totalq4',' int(9) DEFAULT 0');


DELETE FROM s_kpi_height05 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_height05 
( id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year
,target
,result1,result2,result3,result4,result5,result6
,targetq1,resultq1,b2q1,b3q1,a2q1,a3q1
,targetq2,resultq2,b2q2,b3q2,a2q2,a3q2
,targetq3,resultq3,b2q3,b3q3,a2q3,a3q3
,targetq4,resultq4,b2q4,b3q4,a2q4,a3q4
,totalq1,totalq2,totalq3,totalq4
)
(
SELECT
	 @id,h.hoscode hospcode,p.check_vhid as areacode
   ,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF( (AGE_MS >= 0 AND AGE_MS < 72)  OR (AGE_MS1 >= 0 AND AGE_MS1 < 72)
OR (AGE_MS2 >= 0 AND AGE_MS2 < 72) OR (AGE_MS3 >= 0 AND AGE_MS3 < 72) OR (AGE_MS4 >= 0 AND AGE_MS4 < 72)
OR (n.AGE_Y >= 0 AND n.AGE_Y < 6) OR (AGE_T1 >= 0 AND AGE_T1 < 6) OR (AGE_T2 >= 0 AND AGE_T2 < 6)  
OR (AGE_T3 >= 0 AND AGE_T3 < 6) OR (AGE_T4 >= 0 AND AGE_T4 < 6) ,p.cid,NULL)) total


,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MS >= 0 AND AGE_MS < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t4 AND n.weight >0  AND n.height >0,p.cid,NULL)) result1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MS >= 0 AND AGE_MS < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t4 AND h_s in(3,4,5) AND wh in(3),p.cid,NULL)) result2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(p.sex=1 AND p.age_y IN(5) AND n.height>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(p.sex=2  AND p.age_y IN(5) AND n.height>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result4
,SUM(IF(p.sex=1  AND p.age_y IN(5) ,n.height,0)) result5
,SUM(IF(p.sex=2  AND p.age_y IN(5) ,n.height,0)) result6

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT1 >= 0 AND AGE_MT1 < 72 AND AGE_MS1 >= 0 AND AGE_MS1 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t1 AND n.weight1 >0  AND n.height1 >0,p.cid,NULL)) result1q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT1 >= 0 AND AGE_MT1 < 72 AND AGE_MS1 >= 0 AND AGE_MS1 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t1 AND h_s1 in(3,4,5) AND wh1 in(3) ,p.cid,NULL)) result2q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T1 IN(5) AND p.sex=1  AND n.height1>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result3q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T1 IN(5) AND p.sex=2  AND n.height1>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result4q1
,SUM(IF(AGE_T1 IN(5) AND p.sex=1 ,n.height1,0)) result5q1
,SUM(IF(AGE_T1 IN(5) AND p.sex=2 ,n.height1,0)) result6q1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT2 >= 0 AND AGE_MT2 < 72 AND AGE_MS2 >= 0 AND AGE_MS2 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t2 AND n.weight2 >0 AND n.height2 >0,p.cid,NULL)) result1q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT2 >= 0 AND AGE_MT2 < 72 AND AGE_MS2 >= 0 AND AGE_MS2 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t2 AND h_s2 in(3,4,5) AND wh2 in(3) ,p.cid,NULL)) result2q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T2 IN(5) AND p.sex=1  AND n.height2>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result3q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T2 IN(5) AND p.sex=2  AND n.height2>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result4q2
,SUM(IF(AGE_T2 IN(5) AND p.sex=1 ,n.height2,0)) result5q2
,SUM(IF(AGE_T2 IN(5) AND p.sex=2 ,n.height2,0)) result6q2

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT3 >= 0 AND AGE_MT3 < 72 AND AGE_MS3 >= 0 AND AGE_MS3 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t3 AND n.weight3 >0  AND n.height3 >0,p.cid,NULL)) result1q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT3 >= 0 AND AGE_MT3 < 72 AND AGE_MS3 >= 0 AND AGE_MS3 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t3 AND h_s3 in(3,4,5) AND wh3 in(3) ,p.cid,NULL)) result2q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T3 IN(5) AND p.sex=1  AND n.height3>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result3q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T3 IN(5) AND p.sex=2  AND n.height3>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result4q3
,SUM(IF(AGE_T3 IN(5) AND p.sex=1 ,n.height3,0)) result5q3
,SUM(IF(AGE_T3 IN(5) AND p.sex=2 ,n.height3,0)) result6q3

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT4 >= 0 AND AGE_MT4 < 72 AND AGE_MS4 >= 0 AND AGE_MS4 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t4 AND n.weight4 >0 AND n.height4 >0,p.cid,NULL)) result1q4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_MT4 >= 0 AND AGE_MT4 < 72 AND AGE_MS4 >= 0 AND AGE_MS4 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t4 AND h_s4 in(3,4,5) AND wh4 in(3) ,p.cid,NULL)) result2q4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T4 IN(5) AND p.sex=1  AND n.height4>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result3q4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(AGE_T4 IN(5) AND p.sex=2  AND n.height4>0 ,p.cid,NULL)) result4q4
,SUM(IF(AGE_T4 IN(5) AND p.sex=1 ,n.height4,0)) result5q4
,SUM(IF(AGE_T4 IN(5) AND p.sex=2 ,n.height4,0)) result6q4

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  AGE_MT1 >= 0 AND AGE_MT1 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t1,p.cid,NULL)) totalq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  AGE_MT2 >= 0 AND AGE_MT2 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t2,p.cid,NULL)) totalq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  AGE_MT3 >= 0 AND AGE_MT3 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t3,p.cid,NULL)) totalq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  AGE_MT4 >= 0 AND AGE_MT4 < 72 AND n.BIRTH <= @end_t4,p.cid,NULL)) totalq4

FROM
t_nutrition05  n INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON n.CID=p.CID
INNER JOIN  chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c) AND h.hdc_regist=1
WHERE p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9) AND  n.BIRTH <= @end_t4
GROUP BY h.hoscode
);
rows.notice:
ประเมินจากแฟ้ม NUTRITION และแฟ้ม PERSON
เป้าหมาย
เด็กไทยในเขตรับผิดชอบ อายุ 0-5 ปีในปีงบประมาณทุกคน
ผลงาน
- 1 คน หากมีการชั่งน้ำหนักวัดส่วนสูงเกิน 1 ครั้งต่อไตรมาส จะยึดค่าน้ำหนักและส่วนสูงครั้งสุดท้ายของไตรมาส
- 1 คน หากมีการชั่งน้ำหนักวัดส่วนสูง ในหลายไตรมาสจะนับให้ทุกไตรมาสๆมาสละ 1 ครั้ง
- ตัดความซ้ำซ้อนของข้อมูลด้วยเลขบัตรประชาชน

เกณฑ์น้ำหนัก (w) 1=น้อย , 2=ค่อนข้างน้อย ,3=ตามเกณฑ์์ ,4=ค่อนข้างมาก ,5=มาก
เกณฑ์ส่วนสูง (h) 1=เตี้ย , 2=ค่อนข้างเตี้ย ,3=ตามเกณฑ์ ,4=ค่อนข้างสูง ,5=สูง
เกณฑ์น้ำหนักต่อส่วนสูง (wh) 1=ผอม , 2=ค่อนข้างผอม ,3=สมส่วน ,4=ท้วม ,5=เริ่มอ้วน ,6=อ้วน

SET @prov_c:=(SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
SET @end_t1=concat(@b_year-1,'1231');
SET @end_t2=concat(@b_year,'0331');
SET @end_t3=concat(@b_year,'0630');
SET @end_t4=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT
h.hoscode as hospcode,h.hosname,p.PID,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.SEX,p.BIRTH,p.addr
,p.check_vhid,p.NATION,p.check_typearea,p.discharge
,n.age_mt1,n.age_mt2,n.age_mt3,n.age_mt4
,n.date_serv1,n.date_serv2,n.date_serv3,n.date_serv4
,n.weight1,n.weight2,n.weight3,n.weight4
,n.height1,n.height2,n.height3,n.height4
,n.w_s1,n.w_s2,n.w_s3,n.w_s4
,n.h_s1,n.h_s2,n.h_s3,n.h_s4
,n.wh1,n.wh2,n.wh3,n.wh4
,concat(IFNULL(n.w_s1,0),',',IFNULL(n.h_s1,0),',',IFNULL(n.wh1,0)) as result_code1
,concat(IFNULL(n.w_s2,0),',',IFNULL(n.h_s2,0),',',IFNULL(n.wh2,0)) as result_code2
,concat(IFNULL(n.w_s3,0),',',IFNULL(n.h_s3,0),',',IFNULL(n.wh3,0)) as result_code3
,concat(IFNULL(n.w_s4,0),',',IFNULL(n.h_s4,0),',',IFNULL(n.wh4,0)) as result_code4
,if(AGE_MT1 >= 0 AND AGE_MT1 < 72 AND n.birth <= @end_t1,'นับเป้าหมาย',null) as target1 
,if(AGE_MT2 >= 0 AND AGE_MT2 < 72 AND n.birth <= @end_t2,'นับเป้าหมาย',null) as target2
,if(AGE_MT3 >= 0 AND AGE_MT3 < 72 AND n.birth <= @end_t3,'นับเป้าหมาย',null) as target3 
,if(AGE_MT4 >= 0 AND AGE_MT4 < 72 AND n.birth <= @end_t4,'นับเป้าหมาย',null) as target4
 
,IF(n.h_s1 in(3,4,5) AND n.wh1 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq1
,IF(n.h_s2 in(3,4,5) AND n.wh2 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq2
,IF(n.h_s3 in(3,4,5) AND n.wh3 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq3
,IF(n.h_s4 in(3,4,5) AND n.wh4 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq4
FROM
t_nutrition05  n INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON n.CID=p.CID
INNER JOIN  chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c) AND h.hdc_regist=1
WHERE p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9)
);
SELECT 
h.hoscode,h.hosname,d.PID,d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME,d.SEX,d.BIRTH,d.addr,d.check_vhid,d.NATION
,d.check_typearea,d.discharge
,d.age_mt1,d.age_mt2,d.age_mt3,d.age_mt4
,d.date_serv1,d.date_serv2,d.date_serv3,d.date_serv4
,d.weight1,d.weight2,d.weight3,d.weight4
,d.height1,d.height2,d.height3,d.height4
,d.w_s1,d.w_s2,d.w_s3,d.w_s4
,d.h_s1,d.h_s2,d.h_s3,d.h_s4
,d.wh1,d.wh2,d.wh3,d.wh4
,d.result_code1,d.result_code2,d.result_code3,d.result_code4
,d.target1,d.target2,d.target3,d.target4
,IF(d.h_s1 in(3,4,5) AND d.wh1 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq1
,IF(d.h_s2 in(3,4,5) AND d.wh2 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq2
,IF(d.h_s3 in(3,4,5) AND d.wh3 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq3
,IF(d.h_s4 in(3,4,5) AND d.wh4 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS resultq4
FROM tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}
